# MUT Source — AI index

> Modflow User Tools (MUT): Fortran preprocessor for MODFLOW-USG

## Agent entrypoints

- AGENTS.md
- CODE_STANDARDS.md
- Docs/ai/PROGRESS.md
- Docs/ai/DOMAIN_MAP.md
- Docs/ai/BUILD.md
- .cursor/rules/mut-fortran.mdc
- Tools/mut_document/ — model-folder dossier PDF (default after `_build`/`_post`; `no model documentation` skips)
- Tools/mut_verify/ — release-verification appendix (`verify_release.ps1`); `VerificationFolder.List` in `C:\Work\Examples-Release`; publish with `ToRepos.bat`
- Tools/commit_local.ps1 — local git commit; appends `MUTVersion`

CODE_ANALYSIS.md is historical; prefer DOMAIN_MAP.md.

Default FE Tecplot is SZL `.tecplot.szplt`; `write ascii tecplot output` restores `.tecplot.dat`.

## User documentation (TeX — edit, do not mirror)

- Docs/User's Guide/MUT User's Guide.tex
- Package chapters: GWF.tex, CLN.tex, SWF.tex, GSTR.tex, OutputControl.tex, ModelExecution.tex
- Changelog: Modifications.tex
- QGIS appendix: QGIS_Useage.tex
- Release verification appendix: `VerifyRelease.tex` (how to run) plus generated `ReleaseComparison.tex`

## Build

- Docs/build_mut_guide.bat
- Tools/verify_release.ps1
- post_build.bat / post_buildR.bat
